settings.label: Logo for light backgrounds
settings.info: Your BLACK logo. Used in the header, footer and cart.

settings.label: Logo for dark backgrounds
settings.info: Your LIME logo. Used in the mobile menu and dark areas.

settings.label: Accent (neon)
settings.info: The brand neon yellow-green. Used for CTAs, highlights, and accent elements.

settings.label: Default share image
settings.info: Used as the default Open Graph / social share image (1200×1200 recommended).

settings.label: Google Analytics 4 ID
settings.info: e.g. G-XXXXXXXXXX. Leave blank to disable.

settings.label: Meta (Facebook) Pixel ID
settings.info: The 15–16 digit pixel ID from Meta Events Manager. Tracks PageView, ViewContent and AddToCart on the storefront. Leave blank to disable.

name: Contact & location
info: Optional. Fill these in only if you have a physical location/pickup you want shown (adds a map, directions, and local business schema). Leave blank for an online-only store.

settings.label: Google Maps embed URL
settings.info: Google Maps → Share → Embed a map → copy just the src URL.
